role: The @Observable MainActor RRCollector orchestration shell: injected dependencies (including the shared SessionScoringContext), back-compat forwarders to DeviceStatus/SessionState/CollectorSessionControl/SessionScoringContext, archive read helpers, strap-recovery predicates, wiring factory and deferred baseline rebuild; plus RRCollectorError and two file-scope phase label helpers. Saved-session reanalysis is the composition root's SessionReanalysisCoordinator, not the collector's.
types: RRCollector.LiveHRVSnapshotMirror: struct — Sendable snapshot for LiveHRVBroker
RRCollectorError: enum — collector errors with localized descriptions
RRCollector.ArchivedCopy: struct (Hashable, Sendable) — one stored copy of an archived session: session id and file hash, which every rewrite changes
state: RRCollector.scoring: SessionScoringContext (settings, baseline, training load), injected or built from the settings manager, HealthKit and baseline tracker
toplevel: Stored-property initializers: deviceFetchPolicy .automatic, useDeviceBackupForOvernight true, overnightDeviceBackupActive false, isOvernightEnding false, armingRetryInterval = StrapRecordingPolicy.armingRetryIntervalSeconds, streamingTimerBox lock(nil), liveHRVSnapshotMirror lock(nil), didBootBaseline lock(false), verification = Verification(), streamingVerification relaxed config (minPoints from CollectorSessionControl.minimumQuickReadingBeats). typealias CollectorError = RRCollectorError. An RRCollector extension declares ArchivedCopy and holds the baseline rebuild's restart and off-main decode (restartReplacingRebuild(reusing:), rebuildBaselineOffMain(replacing:reusing:)); a file-scope helper, archiveHoldsSession(runningAt:slackMinutes:in:), answers whether an archived night or nap was running at a time. The header doc maps each extension file to the coordinator that owns its behaviour and says saved-session reanalysis belongs to the composition root.

Replacing: when the archive's stored copies (ArchivedCopy: id and file hash) changed since the decode — a night archived, deleted or rewritten under its id, such as a newer iCloud copy — it starts the rebuild over, handing it the sessions just decoded by copy so only new or rewritten entries are decrypted (a night archived meanwhile is not wiped, a rewritten one not scored from its old copy), else resets the tracker; boot: skips if a live session already seeded it. Then rebuildFromSessions with the settings sleep schedule.

branches.cond: replacing and the archive's stored copies differ from the decoded ones
branches.effect: restartReplacingRebuild with the decoded sessions, return
